scope.population: aggregate manufacturer/importer reported releases; not resident consumption
scope.calendar_period_2010_2024: consumer calendar labels consistent with annual series; original annual definitions not independently re-established
scope.heated_products_2025: excluded from smoked-tobacco highlights and reported separately
scope.duty_free_reason: Returns can include duty-free channels, but aggregation of this workbook has not been reconciled to those returns.

locators: Tonnes of tobacco sold per year

conversion.reason: Aggregate tobacco mass is not a count of factory-made cigarettes plus RYO. Product-specific amounts and conversion definitions are required.

measurement_model.status: specified requirements; not fitted or approved
measurement_model.compatible_release_mass: Annual national mass under the same product/channel coverage; not catchment consumption or illicit origin.
measurement_model.resolution_status: integer workbook values; no rounding distribution inferred
measurement_model.covariance_family_for_qualification: Sigma = D R D + tau^2 1 1^T; positive D, SPD R and tau >= 0 must be justified, not assumed fitted.
measurement_model.existing_numeric_interface: tobac.supply.release_loglikelihood requires compatible predictions/units and a supplied SPD covariance
measurement_model.overlapping_periods: Use allocation A and A Sigma A^T; overlapping aggregates are not independent new data.
measurement_model.shared_data: Phyo summaries already reuse MOH returns and NZHS; do not multiply their likelihoods with the same underlying returns.

remaining_gates: original capture timestamp and historical edition
